title: Rav Acha son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 14a, saying: “Thus said Rabbi Chiyya.” But Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads: “R’ Abba son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba said: Thus said Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba.”[^1]

notes.text: William Davidson Berakhot 14a fully names Rav Acha son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, supporting the heading. The alternative attributed to Dikdukei Soferim is Hyman’s report, not a new collation of that apparatus; its abbreviated title before Abba remains R’.
